create_HelloRequest: create a HelloRequest protobuf message with a name field for gRPC requests
create_HelloReply: create a HelloReply protobuf message with a message field for gRPC responses
use_Greeter_SayHello: use the Greeter service SayHello method descriptor to define a gRPC RPC endpoint
inspect_DESCRIPTOR: inspect the helloworld.proto FileDescriptor to list all message types and services
register_HelloRequest: register the HelloRequest message type with the protobuf symbol database for lookup
